title: Customisable Max Health
description: Adds a customisable max health for Fabric 1.20.1.
body:
# Customisable Max Health
Customisable Max Health is a Fabric 1.20.1 mod that allows for the permanent customisation of player max health. All that you need to do is launch the game, and edit the config to what you want.

This mod was made because I was unable to find any mod on Fabric that this did this without any extra additions.

In order to use this mod, you can either directly change the config file, modify through ModMenu in singleplayer, or use the `/maxhealth set <value>` command. Please do note that maxhealth is measure in half hearts, so a maxhealth of 20 is 10 hearts.

Customisable Max Health depends on Cloth Config! Please ensure that you install it in addition to this mod.

CMH supports ModMenu's in-game config modification system.
